pressure_packet.title: Seal the medicine route satchel
pressure_packet.situation: Clara has the final route sheets and wax tab for the clinic courier leaving this afternoon.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Assemble one tamper-evident route satchel before the courier check-in.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The clinic route sheets are signed for today's west loop.
Two route sheets and one wax tab are in Clara's carried stock.

entries.label: Assemble one tamper-evident route satchel before the courier check-in.

pressure_packet.title: Clear the mill service apron
pressure_packet.situation: A fallen brace blocks the marked service apron where Lucas must stage the mill repair cart.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Open the service apron so the repair cart can reach the mill door.

actor_visible_facts.statement: Lucas is on the mill maintenance roster for this shift.
The blocked apron is the only marked cart approach.

entries.label: Open the service apron so the repair cart can reach the mill door.

pressure_packet.title: Release flour to the relief kitchen
pressure_packet.situation: Emma holds the flour reserve assigned to Elin's relief kitchen and the evening batch starts soon.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Transfer the reserved flour to Elin's carried kitchen stock.

actor_visible_facts.statement: Four sealed flour sacks are in Emma's custody.
The relief kitchen receipt names Elin as recipient.

entries.label: Transfer the reserved flour to Elin's carried kitchen stock.

pressure_packet.title: Book the loading crew
pressure_packet.situation: Nolan's produce cart is packed but cannot be moved without the licensed loading crew at the market dock.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Purchase the dock loading service for the packed cart.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The packed cart is waiting in the marked loading bay.
Devin is listed as the licensed crew lead.

entries.label: Purchase the dock loading service for the packed cart.

pressure_packet.title: Hold the cot move for a valid ward seal
pressure_packet.situation: Farah has a transfer note for a clinic cot, but its ward seal belongs to yesterday's shift and no current ward authorization is present.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Avoid moving the cot until a current ward authorization exists.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The only visible ward seal expired at the last shift boundary.
The clinic cot remains inside the restricted ward.

entries.label: Avoid moving the cot until a current ward authorization exists.

pressure_packet.title: Prepare the sterile dressing roll
pressure_packet.situation: Pavel has boiled linen and clean binding thread for the mine first-aid locker.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Craft one sterile dressing roll before the mine crew departs.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The mine first-aid commitment is due this afternoon.
Pavel carries two linen measures and one binding thread.

entries.label: Craft one sterile dressing roll before the mine crew departs.

pressure_packet.title: Flush the sawmill coolant channel
pressure_packet.situation: Felix has been assigned to remove the sawdust plug from the coolant channel before the next cutting cycle.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Flush the marked channel and restore coolant flow.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The maintenance board assigns the coolant channel to Felix.
The saw is idle until the marked channel is flushed.

entries.label: Flush the marked channel and restore coolant flow.

pressure_packet.title: Sell the inspected barley lot
pressure_packet.situation: Devin has an inspected barley lot and the mill counter is buying exactly one lot at the posted price.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Complete the posted sale and obtain coin for the next milling run.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The barley inspection tag matches today's mill lot code.
The mill buyback board posts one lot for three coin.

entries.label: Complete the posted sale and obtain coin for the next milling run.

pressure_packet.title: Move seed grain to the north plot crew
pressure_packet.situation: Elin holds the seed grain released for Grace's north plot crew and planting begins at the next bell.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Transfer the released seed grain to Grace.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The release ledger assigns the north plot seed to Grace.
Elin carries four sealed seed-grain measures.

entries.label: Transfer the released seed grain to Grace.

pressure_packet.title: Arrange an overnight home-care visit
pressure_packet.situation: Jonah's father needs a scheduled overnight check and the clinic has a registered home-care provider available.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Purchase one overnight home-care visit from Quinn.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The household care schedule requires one overnight check.
Quinn is the registered provider on tonight's clinic rota.

entries.label: Purchase one overnight home-care visit from Quinn.
